title: FinMultiHopQA: A KG-Grounded Multi-Hop Financial QA Benchmark for Evidence-Driven Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2510.02906v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-hop financial question answering often requires composing evidence distributed across filing sections, fiscal years, and peer companies. Prior financial QA benchmarks address parts of this problem individually, but none jointly support controlled multi-hop taxonomies, document topologies, motif-level reproducibility, and provenance-linked auditability at scale. We introduce FinMultiHopQA, a benchmark of 15,600 qualitative and quantitative questions, grounded in FinReflectKG, a temporally indexed financial knowledge graph derived from SEC 10-K filings with 17.5M+ triples. The pipeline instantiates statistically salient 2-3 hop typed KG motifs across intra-document, inter-year, and cross-company regimes. translated_title: FinMultiHopQA：一个基于知识图谱的多跳金融问答基准，面向证据驱动的推理
translated_abstract: 多跳金融问答通常需要综合分布在申报文件不同章节、不同财年以及同业公司之间的证据。以往的金融问答基准只分别解决了该问题的部分方面，但没有任何一个基准能够同时支持受控的多跳分类体系、文档拓扑结构、基于模体的可复现性以及大规模的溯源可审计性。我们提出了FinMultiHopQA，一个包含15,600个定性与定量问题的基准，其建立在FinReflectKG之上——这是一个从SEC 10-K申报文件中提取的、具有时间索引的金融知识图谱，包含超过1750万条三元组。该构建流程在文档内、跨年度和跨公司三种模式下实例化统计显著的2-3跳带类型知识图谱模体。除了填补这一空白之外，同样的构建方式还使我们能够在保持每个问题底层证据不变的情况下，仅改变其呈现方式——例如将其嵌入嘈杂的上下文中或改变其顺序——从而实现受控的……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了FinMultiHopQA基准，包含15,600个定性与定量问题，基于从SEC 10-K申报文件构建的、含1750万+三元组的金融知识图谱FinReflectKG，支持跨章节、跨财年、跨公司的多跳证据推理，并能控制证据呈现方式的变化以实现可复现、可审计的评测。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces FinMultiHopQA, a benchmark of 15,600 qualitative and quantitative questions grounded in FinReflectKG, a temporally indexed financial knowledge graph with 17.5M+ triples derived from SEC 10-K filings, enabling controlled, reproducible, and auditable multi-hop evidence-driven reasoning across document sections, fiscal years, and peer companies.
